aciklama: Bölüm 4 görsellerinin üretim istemleri ve kaydı. Üslup ve yasaklar b10.json'daki ile aynı (u01-d); dönem 571-576, Mekke ve Sa'doğulları yurdu.

uslup.istem: Flat-shape illustration for a documentary motion comic in a paper cut-out style: layered flat shapes with clear depth planes, each plane like a sheet of textured paper with a soft shadow beneath it. Muted, low-saturation earth palette: sand, ochre, raw umber, warm grey stone; deep indigo for night, soft apricot for dawn and dusk. Gentle atmospheric haze, clean readable silhouettes, calm and respectful mood. Setting: Arabia around 571-576 CE — Mecca (a narrow valley among bare, rocky mountains with small flat-roofed houses of mudbrick and rough stone) and the dry steppe lands of the Bedouin tribe of Banu Sa'd. Cinematic 16:9 framing.

referans.not: u01-d, Erdem seçti (2026-11-13). Her üretime image_references olarak verilir; yalnız üslup ve palet için, kompozisyon için değil.

uslup.yasaklar: No minarets, no domes, no crescents, no arches, no tiles, no Ottoman or modern architecture, no modern Masjid al-Haram. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. Ordinary people may show their faces, drawn simply in the same flat paper cut-out style, dignified, not photorealistic. The Prophet Muhammad appears only when the prompt asks for him, and then only as a tall, dignified figure entirely covered in soft warm golden-white light, wearing a green turban; no face, skin, hands or body detail visible inside the light. His wives, children, parents and wet nurse never show a face: only from behind, as distant silhouettes, or as hands and fabric details. No other prophet in any form: no figure, silhouette, shadow, hand or foot, only a soft warm light. No angels. No blood.
uslup.katman_kurali: Katmanlar ayrı üretilir. Gök katmanı hariç her katman düz, tek renk #00B140 (yeşil perde) zemin üzerinde istenir; zemin sonra `tools/gorsel_katman.py` ile silinip şeffaf WebP yapılır. Konu yeşil içeriyorsa (ör. s06'daki yeşil temel taşları) zemin mavi perde #0047BB istenir ve betik `--mavi` ile çalıştırılır; gök `--opak` ile. Görsel 16:9 kadrajdan her yöne %10 taşacak genişlikte düşünülür; ana öğe alt %25'e (altyazı alanı) düşmez.
uslup.yesil_perde_eki: Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-green background (#00B140), no shadows on the background, no green tint on the subject.

Şakk-ı sadr: olay, melek, ışık, beden çizilmez; yalnız boş manzara.
Halîme ve Âmine: yüz yok (arkadan, siluet, örtü, uzak plan).

Kâbe: Abdülmuttalib dönemi, çatısız alçak Kâbe (kabe-alcak).

FRAMING: only the band of the face from the middle of the forehead to just below the eyes fills the whole image: both eyes are very large, side by side, the first eye centred in the LEFT half of the image and the second eye centred in the RIGHT half, the bridge of the nose in the middle; brows, lashes, eyelids and skin are simple layered paper shapes; skin, brows, hair and head cloth exactly as this boy in the attached front-view image. Each iris is very large (about two thirds of the image height) and holds a large, sharp, easy-to-read reflection, like a small round painting set in the dark, glossy iris, with one small white highlight at its upper left. The two eyes show TWO DIFFERENT moments: the reflection in the left eye is NOT repeated in the right eye. Every reflection shows the same sunlit hillside as the attached hillside image, seen from where the children stand: clear blue daytime sky, the far mountains, the tree at the left, brown grass and a few lambs; NOT dusk, NOT night. Only two lights are in the reflections, drawn with exactly the same simple shapes in every eye: THE CHILD is a soft, round, warm golden-white ORB of light, like a small sun resting on the grass, about as big as a lamb's body; lying, it is a slightly flattened oval glow on the grass; standing, a slightly taller oval glow. It is only a glow: NO head, NO body, NO limbs, NO face, NOT a candle flame; it rests on the grass by itself, never on or near a lamb's head. THE VISITOR is a tall, smooth PILLAR of soft white misty light with a rounded top and blurred edges, about three times taller than the orb and as wide as a lamb, standing on the grass. It is only a smooth pillar: NO head, NO shoulders, NO arms, NO hands, NO wings, NOT a candle, no flame and no smoke on top. When it bends over, the whole pillar curves over in one smooth arch, its rounded top coming down close to the orb. When it lifts or holds something, that thing simply floats in the glow at the top end of the pillar or arch; there are no hands. There is no human, child or angel shape anywhere in the reflections. LEFT EYE: a simple, plain golden basin filled with clear water stands on the grass beside the golden orb, which still lies flat as an oval glow; the white pillar is curved over the basin in an arch, and the bright golden spark floats at its lowered top just above the water; the water sparkles and a few clear drops fall from the spark back into the basin. RIGHT EYE: the bright spark has gone back into the golden orb, which glows whole again and now rests upright on the slope as a slightly taller oval glow (still no head, no body); the golden basin is gone; high in the blue sky the white pillar, straight again, rises away and fades, still a smooth pillar with no arms and no wings; the lambs graze again.
